messages:
alex.nguyen: Hey all, I'm Alex (joined today). I can load console staging but when I try /admin/feature-flags I get a 403. Need access to validate a small canary. Anyone own FF admin on staging? :wave:
leah_infra: welcome! usually group mapping. Can you confirm exact url and try an incognito window to rule out cached session?
alex.nguyen: url: https://console.staging.redwood.ai/admin/feature-flags. Incognito same 403. Main console loads but the admin path is blocked.
leah_infra: ah that suggests UI-level RBAC. Quick API check: run `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/me` and paste the `groups` array (please redact tokens).
alex.nguyen: did that, groups: ["engineering"]. No admin groups.
jamie-peopleops: We can do JIT staging elevation for new hires. Sam approves platform elevations.
sam.platform: I can approve for 4-8 hours. Alex, open an onboarding ticket ONB with subject `staging-ff-need` and include manager + reason. I'll sign off quickly.
alex.nguyen: just created ONB-4972, included manager @maria.tan and noted the canary test and times.
sam.platform: Approved. @onboarding-bot execute.
onboarding-bot: Granted role `staging-ff-admin` to alex.nguyen until 2026-03-23T16:12:00Z. Audit: AUD-20260323-7812.
alex.nguyen: access works now, thanks! I can see the FF list. Quick q: where's the canonical canary checklist so I follow ops requirements?
leah_infra: See runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/feature-flags/canary-runbook. TL;DR: 1-2% initial, monitor errors and latency for 15m, then step to 10/25. Auto-rollback thresholds: +50% error or p95 +200ms. Use preview mode and try a smoke test before ramp.
jamie-peopleops: If you want a walkthrough later, I can pair with you. Also keep the ONB ticket for the audit trail.
alex.nguyen: appreciated. One more: will I need prod FF admin later? What's the process?
sam.platform: Prod requires manager sign-off and security review; staging JIT is common for devs. For prod, file a request with justification and expected windows.
maria.tan: welcome aboard Alex! ping me if you want me to join the canary pairing.
